subject: Data Engineering
title: Backfills and Replays
description: A micro-lesson that makes Backfills and Replays usable.

hook.text: You found a bug in last month's transform logic. The fix is easy. Correcting 30 days of data is not.

buildup.text: A backfill reruns a pipeline for a historical range, overwriting bad data with corrected results.

discovery.text: Idempotent pipelines make backfills safe because reprocessing won't create duplicates.

twist.text: Backfilling a year of data can take days and compete with production workloads for resources.

climax.text: Teams that design for backfills from day one save themselves enormous pain when bugs inevitably appear.

punchline.text: Every pipeline will need a backfill eventually. Plan for it.

quiz.question: What is a data pipeline backfill?
options: Rerunning a pipeline for historical data to correct errors
Adding new data sources to a pipeline
